## 2f0b1cb87615

**Pinned generator SHA-256:**
`366e081abbab1cf88fa7fb5dfe9627eb08ec9f23aaee53d1774ba33194707b54`.

### AUD-2F-1 — Reproduced override-contract and false-diversity failures

The official override stage ran 46,800 draws over 520 cases and found 9,624
blocking findings. Categories included 3,240 override mismatches, 5,040
self-check failures, 1,110 generation errors, 50 axis-effect failures, missing
axis provenance/metadata, and silent acceptance of an unknown key. It also
recorded 23,100 undeclared multi-axis rejections under the legacy compatibility
policy. Exact counts and minimized witnesses are in
`checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-override/checks/2f0b1cb87615_audit_override_results.json`.

A compact replay at seed 0, sample index 3, difficulty `easy` makes the data
quality consequence explicit. The default grid and overrides
`palette_kind=warm`, `palette_kind=cool`, `palette_size=4`,
`n_distinct_colors=4`, `texture=warm`, and an unknown key all have the identical
normalized grid SHA-256
`a9233ac48460c95682dd4f20b9df908e0655f0ae29c570400cb04cb2d995d919`.
Thus several advertised controls add no diversity for that replay, while a typo
is silently treated as success. Separately,
`texture=no_prototypes, grid_h=11` returns a 10×13 grid, ignores the requested
height, and fails `self_check` for having no prototype.

**Evidence:**

- `checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615/override-contract/counterexample.json`
- `checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-override/result.json`
- `checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-override/checks/2f0b1cb87615_audit_override.log`
- `checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-override/checks/2f0b1cb87615_audit_override_results.json`

**Reproducer:** from `WORK/`,
`python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles check 2f0b1cb87615 --stage override --timeout 600 --phase audit --out ../checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-override`.

### AUD-2F-2 — Missing rule pin, tests, and semantic contract

The lint stage reports missing required `RULE_HASH` and two unprobeable
single-token axes. The combined audit reports no task-local/frozen tests and no
semantic contract. Evidence:
`checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-battery/checks/2f0b1cb87615_audit_lint.log` and
`checks/audit/2f0b1cb87615-combined/result.json`. The broader battery completed
self-check and rule smoke, failed lint, and was interrupted during defect lint;
remaining stages were not completed and are not claimed.

No target source was changed.

## 2f0b1cb87615

**Source-bound supplementary API finding; no peer source was changed.** Ticket
`ticket-6e4e0446a4bfbf97` inspected generator VERSION `1.1.1`, SHA-256
`366e081abbab1cf88fa7fb5dfe9627eb08ec9f23aaee53d1774ba33194707b54`,
with pinned rule hash `65fad7861ecf`.

The advertised `texture` axis declares the finite set
`default|warm|cool|varied|no_sketch|no_prototypes|sketch_color_no_proto`.
One ticket-seeded valid/invalid comparison held seed and `sample_index=0`
constant and changed only `texture`: declared-valid `warm` versus undeclared
`not-a-texture`.  Both calls were accepted, both returned `self_check == []`,
neither override appeared in `GenCtx.overrides_used()`, and both returned the
same 9×12 grid with SHA-256
`10e3f80268a0a4744a883d2f3531873b4dc674ebbd3ab794f532ca192445966a`.
Thus the ordinary helpful `texture` values and an invalid enum value silently
fall through to the same default generation path; only the three degenerate
names are read directly before `GenCtx`.

Evidence is retained at
`checks/tickets/ticket-6e4e0446a4bfbf97/report.json`, with the runnable single
probe in `probe.py`, launcher receipt in `receipt.json`, and concise stdout in
`console.log`.  Scope is exactly one advertised boundary and one valid/invalid
pair.  This finding is reviewer-reported and remains unverified until maintainer
assessment; it makes no claim about unrelated axes or later source versions.
